title: fix(plugin-list, plugin-kanban, plugin-grid, app-shell): cards whose click opens nothing draw no pointer, and an authored none row opens no tab on a modifier click
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XBJ7DmLnAJqHjfG7rG3PAw8)_

domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mW5PFQoLHxgbsuizT

Fixes #33548

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表的行点了不会打开任何东西时(视图写了 `navigation.mode: 'none'`,或对象只开放 `list`),手机卡片、画廊卡片、看板卡片不再显示手型指针和悬停浮起效果;卡片上的操作(手机卡片的「⋮」)照旧。另外,视图写了 `none` 时,⌘/Ctrl+点击或中键点击行也不再在新标签页打开记录。
- 为什么改:#33317 只让表格行不像链接,同一个列表换成卡片、画廊或看板还是看起来能点,点了没反应;⌘+点击还会打开一个视图声明「不导航」的记录。
- 风险与回滚:画廊和看板各多一个可选宿主属性 `rowOpensRecord`(与表格同名),不传时与之前完全一样;能打开记录的列表(抽屉、页面)行为不变,⌘+点击照旧开新标签页;可拖动的看板卡片保留抓手光标和拖动语义;既不能拖也打不开的看板卡片不再是按钮、不占 Tab 停留位、不响应 Enter/空格。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` 的 `handleRowClick` 里新加的 `overlay.mode === 'none'` 一行;`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 的 `ROW_OPENS_RECORD_VIEW_TYPES`;`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx` 的 `KanbanCardsOpenRecord`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.cardFacesOpenNothing-33548.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx`,预期 21 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Measured on `origin/main` `d95ddebc` (#33544 included) before the fix**, each face on a list whose rows open nothing:

| Face | Pointer / link styling on `main` | Tap on `main` | What decides it on `main` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Phone card (grid below 768 px) | `cursor-pointer` and `hover:bg-accent/50`, unconditional | reaches the host's `onRowClick`, which opens nothing | `ObjectGrid` `buildMobileCardRenderer`: the `data-testid="grid-mobile-card"` div's literal class string. The grid already received `rowOpensRecord` but the card never read it |
| Gallery card | `cursor-pointer` plus the hover lift (`hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5`) | same | `ObjectGallery` `renderCard`: `(props.onCardClick \|\| props.onRowClick \|\| schema.navigation) && 'cursor-pointer'`, and `ListView` handed `rowOpensRecord` to `object-grid` only |
| Board card | `cursor-pointer` on a card that cannot be dragged (`cursor-grab` on one that can), plus the hover lift | same | `KanbanImpl` `SortableCard`: `movable ? "cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing" : "cursor-pointer"` |
| ⌘/Ctrl/middle click on an authored `none` grid row | n/a | opens the record in a new tab | console `objectViewRecordNavigation` `handleRowClick` hands a modifier click to `navOverlay.handleClick`; `useNavigationOverlay` `handleClick` opens `new_window` on `event.metaKey \|\| event.ctrlKey \|\| event.button === 1` before it reads `mode === 'none'` |

No face failed to reproduce, so nothing is pinned as already fixed.

**The fix** (every face reads #33544's `rowOpensRecord`; no second name):

- **`ListView`** hands its `rowOpensRecord` to `object-grid`, `object-gallery` and `object-kanban` (`ROW_OPENS_RECORD_VIEW_TYPES`), on the same host channel #33544 used for the grid.
- **Phone card (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`).** `rowOpensRecord === false` drops `cursor-pointer` and the hover wash. The "⋮" stays; the click still reaches `onRowClick`, as on the desktop row.
- **Gallery (`@object-ui/plugin-list`).** `ObjectGalleryProps` gains `rowOpensRecord?: boolean`; `false` drops the pointer and the hover lift. Links inside a card stay links.
- **Board (`@object-ui/plugin-kanban`).** `ObjectKanbanComponentProps` gains `rowOpensRecord?: boolean`, forwarded through the internal `KanbanBoardCore` and `KanbanBoard` to every `SortableCard` by context (the way `cardsMovable` already travels). A card that cannot be dragged and opens nothing is no control at all (`control = movable || opens` false in `SortableCard`): the wrapper gets no dnd-kit attributes (no `tabindex`, `aria-roledescription` or `aria-describedby`), no `role="button"` and no `aria-label`, Enter and Space activate nothing, and the face drops the pointer, the hover lift and the `group` class that drives the title's `group-hover:text-primary`. Its click still reaches `onCardClick`, which the host routes to nothing. A draggable card keeps its grab cursor, hover and drag semantics, because a drag is still something it does.
- **⌘-click (`@object-ui/app-shell`).** The card's ruling: an authored `none` row opens no record by any click. `handleRowClick` now returns on `overlay.mode === 'none'` before it reads the modifier, beside the existing list-only return. The shared `useNavigationOverlay` hook is unchanged: its `none` check sits on one line with `preventNavigation`, which card #33549 owns.
- Absent `rowOpensRecord` ⇒ every face is what it was.

**Docs.** `plugin-list`, `plugin-kanban` and `plugin-grid` READMEs and the matching `content/docs/frontend/plugins/` pages say which faces read the prop and what they drop.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/33548-card-faces-open-nothing.md` (patch for plugin-grid, plugin-list, plugin-kanban, app-shell and console). It carries a sentence superseding the pending #33317 note's "still opens the record in a new tab, as before"; that note is not edited.

## Tests

- **New: `ObjectView.cardFacesOpenNothing-33548.test.tsx`** (12 cases), through the real `ObjectView`, `ListView`, gallery, board and grid and the real `MePermissionsProvider`; one differential per case, only the view's `navigation`, the served operations or the edit grant differ:
  - gallery, authored `none` and list-only: no pointer, no hover lift; a click and a ⌘-click change no location and open no tab. CONTROL (default drawer): pointer, a click opens `?recordId=c1`, a ⌘-click opens one tab.
  - board, a card the reader may not drag, authored `none` and list-only: no pointer, no hover lift; click, Enter and Ctrl-click open nothing; and the card is no control: no `role="button"`, no `tabindex="0"`, no title hover. A draggable card under `none` keeps `cursor-grab`, the button role and the tab stop, and gains no pointer. CONTROL (default drawer, not draggable): pointer, button role, tab stop and title hover; Enter opens the drawer, and so does a click.
  - phone card (375 px), list-only: no pointer, no hover wash, the "⋮" (`grid-card-actions`) stays, a tap opens nothing. CONTROL (served object): pointer, a tap opens `/record/c1`.
- **Updated: `ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx`.** The pin that expected a new tab on ⌘-click under authored `none` now expects none for ⌘, Ctrl and `button: 1`; new: a list-only object opens no tab on ⌘ or middle click; new CONTROL: the default drawer opens a tab on each of the three.

A real middle click fires `auxclick`, which no row handler listens to; the pins drive `click` with `button: 1`, the shape `handleRowClick` reads.

**Ablation** (legs A1b–A5 on head `98ef7bee`, leg A6 on `e22e358e`; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` from `src/`, so no `dist/` is in the path):

| Leg | File, anchor → replacement | Pins that went red (of 18 in the two files at `98ef7bee`, 21 at `e22e358e`) |
|---|---|---|
| A1b phone card | `ObjectGrid.tsx` `rowOpensRecord !== false && 'cursor-pointer hover:bg-accent/50',` → `(rowOpensRecord !== false \|\| true) && …` | 1: phone card, list-only |
| A2 gallery | `ObjectGallery.tsx` `const cardOpens = props.rowOpensRecord !== false;` → `Boolean(props) \|\| …` | 2: gallery authored `none`, gallery list-only |
| A3b board | `KanbanImpl.tsx` `const opens = React.useContext(KanbanCardsOpenRecord)` → `true \|\| …` | 2: board authored `none`, board list-only |
| A4 ListView forwarding | `ListView.tsx` `ROW_OPENS_RECORD_VIEW_TYPES.has(viewComponentSchema.type)` → the old grid-only test | 4: both gallery and both board cases |
| A5 ⌘-click | `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` `if (overlay.mode === 'none') return;` deleted | 3: the updated #33317 ⌘/Ctrl/middle pin, plus gallery and board authored `none` (their ⌘/Ctrl clicks) |
| A6 board control | `KanbanImpl.tsx` `const control = movable \|\| opens` → `true \|\| movable \|\| opens` | 4 failed, 17 passed: board authored `none` and list-only, both the face pins and the no-control pins |

Every leg: `ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0`, then `ok restored: blob == HEAD … and git diff HEAD is empty`; all CONTROL cases stayed green on every leg. The first tries of A1 and A3 were refused by the tool before running (`the replacement count moved 1 -> 1` / `the anchor count moved 1 -> 1`: the replacement and anchor were substrings of each other), so they measured nothing; A1b and A3b are the rerun with distinct replacements.

## Acceptance notes

- **Phone, authored `none`: rows still open the record page.** On a phone the console resolves every served object's rows to `page` "whatever the view or the object declares" (objectstack#27058's rule in `objectViewRecordNavigation`), so an authored `none` list opens records there, and its phone cards correctly keep the pointer. Probed through the real `ObjectView` at 375 px on this branch: a tap went to `/apps/setup/demo_credential/record/c1`. This contradicts the spec's "No navigation (read-only list)" and this card's ruling; it is reported to the seat as an open question, not changed here.
- **Compact and capped list postures** (`ListViewCompactRows`, `ListViewCappedRows`) draw their rows as buttons / pointer rows and are not handed `rowOpensRecord`; the console's object list does not mount them. Reported to the seat, not changed.
